sentences.text:
Sanjay And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10
December, 2024

Author: Samit Gopal
Bench: Samit Gopal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:193096
Court No. - 80
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 20483 of 2017
Applicant :- Sanjay And 5 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Nishith Tripathi,Rajesh Kumar Pandey,Sarvesh Kumar Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Dushyant Singh,G.A.,M.C. Singh,Virendra Singh
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Nishith Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Virendra Singh, learned counsel
for the opposite party no. 2, Sri Triveni Saran Rai, learned counsel for the State and perused the
records.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Sanjay,
Prakash Chand, Smt. Munni Devi, Km. Pushpa, Km. Seema, Sonu with the prayer to quash the
Criminal Case No. 3310 of 2017, arising out of Case Crime No. 1317 of 2016, State of U.P. and
another vs. Sanjay and others, challenging the charge sheet dated 02.02.2017 under Sections 498A,
323, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Sanjay And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 December, 2024

entities.text:
Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Sanjay And 5 Others vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is further prayed to stay the further proceedings of said criminal case and the charge
sheet during pendency of this application.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicants argued that the parties have settled the dispute amicably out of court and the said compromise has been filed in Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. No.
21481 of 2018 (Sanjay and 2 others vs. State of U.P. and another) before this Court in which an order for verification of the compromise was passed on 10.09.2024 since the present dispute has also been referred to in the said compromise and settlement between the parties.

entities.text: Sanjay and 2 others vs. State of U.P. and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is argued that in compliance of the order dated 10.09.2024 of this Court, the parties have filed the order of this Court along with the compromise before the concerned court for its verification after which the concerned court has verified the said compromise vide its order dated 09.10.2024, copy of the said order is on the record.

It is argued that the opposite party no. 2 is not interested to pursue the matter pending in the trial court and is not inclined to give any evidence against the applicants and therefore the impugned proceedings be quashed on the ground of compromise between the parties.

4. Learned State counsel as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 could not dispute the fact that the matter has been amicably settled between the parties which was duly verified by the concerned trial court.

5. The law with regards to quashing of a case on the basis of settlement arrived between the parties,
is well settled.

The Apex Court in the cases of (1) B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another: (2003)4 SCC 675; (2) Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation : (2008) 9 SCC 677; (3) Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others: ( 2008) 16 SCC 1; (4) Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab:
(2012) 10 SCC 303; (5) Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. And another: 2013 (83) ACC 278 and (6) Parbatbhai Ahir@Parbatbhai @ Bhimsinbhai Karmur and others Vs. State of Gujarat and another: (2017) 9 SCC 641 has held that the cases in which the parties have settled their grievances can be quashed.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
From perusal of the records and the law laid down by the Apex Court on the subject matter, the present case is a good case for exercising powers by this Court to quash the proceedings and the charge sheet as prayed for by the applicants no. 2 to 6.
7.

8. The proceedings and the charge sheet in the aforementioned case are hereby quashed against the applicants no. 2 to 6 since the present application only survives with regards to them and in so far as the applicant no. 1 is concerned, the present application was disposed of vide order dated 10.07.2017 passed by Hon'ble Vipin Sinha,J. (as he was then).

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 10.12.2024 Naresh  Sanjay And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185347035/
